new_user_requirements.title: Evolve trust through recursive Bayesian evaluation of attributable interactions and observed outcomes
new_user_requirements.acceptance: Every posterior binds subject/dimension/context/model/metric/prior/evidence/dependence/uncertainty/expiry; updates preserve positive, negative, missing and corrected evidence and never become truth or permission

new_user_requirements.title: Apply scoped evaluation to every human, agent, model, source, tool, sensor, metric, evaluator, process and connected system
new_user_requirements.acceptance: No subject class receives an infallibility exemption; models remain use-specific and evidence-limited; evaluation scope does not authorize surveillance or one universal score

new_user_requirements.title: Never accept authority blindly
new_user_requirements.acceptance: Every consequential authority claim verifies authenticated principal, delegation source, exact scope/target/data/time/purpose, expiry/revocation/conflict, consent and action legitimacy; reliability neither grants nor substitutes authority

new_user_requirements.title: Govern objective metrics as versioned reproducible measurements with explicit construct validity and error
new_user_requirements.acceptance: Metrics declare construct/unit/source/sampling/noise/privacy/missingness/dependence/gaming/drift/signing/version/appeal; changes create a new lineage and cannot silently rewrite historical scores

new_user_requirements.title: Recursively evaluate sources, metrics, evaluators and trust models with bounded stopping rules
new_user_requirements.acceptance: Primary outcomes, measurement validity, evaluator calibration/conflicts and model assumptions are assessed at declared depth; unresolved regress stays uncertain/held; dependency clusters prevent clone evidence from inflating confidence

new_user_requirements.title: Prevent Bayesian trust from becoming permission, punishment, discrimination or a human-worth score
new_user_requirements.acceptance: Posteriors change reliance/verification only; high trust bypasses no gate, low trust removes no standing/appeal; protected traits/ideology/status/obedience and proxies are excluded; evidence is minimized and consequential updates are challengeable

changes.change: Add multidimensional ReliabilityPosterior and TrustUpdate records scoped by subject, claim/action dimension, context, model and metric version.

Record priors, likelihood/update rule, evidence window, dependence clusters, effective sample size, uncertainty, calibration, drift, expiry and sensitivity; distinguish missing/unknown from success/failure.
Create signed/versioned MetricDefinition with construct, unit, source/sampling, error, privacy, missingness/selection/dependence, Goodhart/drift tests and appeal/replacement.
Recursively evaluate measurement and evaluator calibration/conflicts plus model assumptions at bounded declared depth; retain unresolved regress as a hold.
Add AuthorityClaim verification for authenticated principal, delegation, scope/target/data/time/purpose, expiry/revocation/conflict, consent and legitimacy on each consequential use.
Make reliability and authority orthogonal: no posterior grants permission, no authority claim establishes truth and owner/system authority receives the same scoped verification.
Enforce purpose-limited evidence, no protected/ideological/status/obedience priors or proxies, no global worth score, no low-trust loss of basic standing/appeal and no high-trust gate bypass.
Explain domain/version limits, correlation, metric changes, unknown observations and authority mismatch in plain language; expose posterior lineage and decisive factors only to authorized inspectors.

Use source-dependency-aware posteriors and versioned metrics for contests/debates without treating scores as truth/alignment/authority or allowing participants to choose outcomes/metrics after observation.

Add prior sensitivity, correlation, selection/missingness, calibration, Goodhart, poisoning, evaluator capture, drift, sparse pooling, proxy discrimination, authority spoof and posterior-to-permission leakage tests.

implementation_state: ARCHITECTURE_AND_TEST_SPECIFICATION_ONLY; no trust model, surveillance, authority grant, contest or effect activation follows
